thesis: The speakers argue that while the industry mostly agrees on the principle that more diversification is better, most portfolios remain heavily concentrated in stocks and bonds due to the difficulty of adding alternative assets. This difficulty stems from the fact that adding diversifiers requires selling existing holdings, which creates high hurdles related to transparency, cost, tax efficiency, and investor behavior.
